errors.text: The FEP mechanism is described as perturbing from a solid reference state to a liquid target state. The intended use is MTP-to-DFT free-energy perturbation within separately sampled solid and liquid ensembles; direct solid-to-liquid FEP would generally have inadequate phase-space overlap.
The required SRO finite-size boundary is not reconstructed: the target uses a 12x12x12, 3456-atom supercell, whereas the hypothesis gives only an unsupported >500-atom criterion.
